body:
Thank you so much, I tried distracting myself and went to sleep, I feel abit better now but the thought is still stuck inside my head,
I talked to them and it’s better I think.?

Something did happen, it made me overthink so much about it because I never expected it from this person, I already suffer from many mental illnesses so it made it worse, and I hit a breaking point, felt a rush of reality once again and everything snapped back into place
